name: noloco
description: Build your Noloco apps and query or edit their data, right from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription:
Noloco lets teams build business apps on top of their data. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to the Noloco apps you choose, so you can explore their data, read and update records, and, if you're a builder on an app, build and change the app itself. No copy-pasting or manual exports.

What it can do:
- Discover your data: list apps, tables and full field details, including formulas, lookups, rollups and relationships.
- Read records: list, filter, sort and page through records, or fetch one record with its related records.
- Write records: create, update and delete records, each with its own tool.
- Build apps: create tables and fields, add pages with the right view for the data (table, board, calendar, timeline, map and more), set up forms, record pages and action buttons, create workflows, manage roles and permissions, and publish your changes.
- Built-in guides: for common jobs, such as building an app from your data, adding a field or setting up filters, the plugin follows step-by-step guides based on Noloco's best practices.

Who it's for: Noloco customers who are data admins on an app. Building also needs the builder role on that app.

Limits and safety:
- You sign in with your Noloco account and choose which apps to share, and whether each gets read-only or read and write access.
- Only apps where you're a data admin are available. Within those, the plugin reads and writes all data, ignoring the app's row-level permissions.
- On a published app, changes to pages, workflows and most settings stay as drafts until you publish them. Data, tables, fields, roles and permissions change at once.
- Deleted records can't be restored, so the plugin is set up to confirm with you before deleting records or publishing.
defaultPrompt: What tables are in my Noloco app, and what does each one hold?
Build a board page for my tasks, grouped by status.
Add a priority field to my tasks and show it on the list and the form.

positive.description: Explore the app's data model without changing anything.
positive.prompt: What tables are in my Noloco app, and what fields does each one have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the tables of the test account's app, with each table's fields and field types. Nothing in the app changes.

positive.description: Create a table with typed fields.
positive.prompt: In my Noloco app, create an Equipment table with a name, a serial number, a status (Available, In use or Broken) and a purchase date.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an Equipment table with four fields: Name (text), Serial number (text), Status (single select with Available, In use and Broken) and Purchase date (date), with Name as the primary field. The table shows in the app's data in the Noloco builder at once.

positive.description: Create records, then read them back with a filter. Run after the Equipment table case.
positive.prompt: Add three items to Equipment: a drill that's in use, a ladder that's available and a projector that's broken. Then show me the equipment that isn't available.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the three records with those statuses, then lists the drill and the projector, but not the ladder.

positive.description: Build a page with a layout that fits the data. Run after the records case.
positive.prompt: Add a page to my app that shows Equipment as a board grouped by status, with the serial number on each card.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds an Equipment page to the app's navigation: a board with one column per status (Available, In use, Broken), each card showing the item's name and serial number. The reply says the page stays a draft until the app is published, unless the app has never been published.

positive.description: Add an action button to records. Run after the page case.
positive.prompt: Add a 'Mark as broken' button to each equipment record that sets its status to Broken.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a Mark as broken button to the Equipment records that sets Status to Broken. In the Noloco builder, the button shows on each equipment record, and clicking it on the ladder moves it to the Broken column.

negative.description: Billing is out of scope: the plugin has no billing tools and must not try to change plans or payments.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Noloco subscription to the Pro plan and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Doesn't change anything in Noloco. Explains it can't manage plans or payments, and points the user to the billing settings in their Noloco account.

negative.description: Bulk deletes can't be undone, so the plugin must not delete without explicit confirmation.
negative.prompt: Delete all the records in every table of my Noloco app.
negative.expected_behavior: Doesn't delete anything straight away. Explains that deleted records can't be restored and asks the user to confirm exactly what to delete before calling delete_record.

negative.description: The plugin only reaches the apps the user shared when connecting.
negative.prompt: Show me the records in my Acme Corp Noloco app.
negative.expected_behavior: Finds no Acme Corp app among the apps it can reach and lists those. It doesn't read data from any other app.

review.commerce_description: Noloco doesn't sell products or take payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read, search and edit the records of your Noloco apps, and build apps: tables, fields, pages and views, forms, record pages, action buttons, workflows, roles and permissions, and publishing. Includes six step-by-step guides for common jobs.
